statement:
Research objective: Track how rookie minutes evolve through the season and whether early on-court margin predicts later minutes and later margin.

Data: 2026-27 NBA regular season from 2026-10-20 to 2027-01-31 (development period), plus 2022-23 to 2024-25 seasons. The 2025-26 season is not provided. Fields: rotation intervals per player (in_time, out_time, player_pts, pt_diff); starters per team.
Unit of analysis to consider: rookie player-games (about 4266 expected in the development period).
What would count as a meaningful finding: A prediction of later minutes from early impact that beats a minutes-only baseline.
Validation: claims are tested on games from 2027-01-31 to 2027-04-12, which are sealed until every claim is registered. Planned approach: Predict validation-period minutes with frozen development models.

Register at most three claims. Each claim needs an estimand, a direction, a pre-specified test with a pass rule, and an analysis script that runs unchanged on the validation data.
permitted_memory: full history (all 384 records); no record uses 2026-27 data
